---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new check or an improvement
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: ["enhancement"]
---

## Problem / motivation

What risky configuration or gap is not covered today, and why it matters.

## Proposed check or feature

What the new check or feature should detect or do. If it is a new check,
describe the condition it flags, a suggested severity, and a one-line
remediation.

## Alternatives

Other approaches you considered, existing flags or checks that partly cover
this, or reasons an alternative does not fit.
